$schema.description: Path to this schema, relative to the configuration file.

externals.description: Modules supplied by the consuming application rather than this bundle.

forbiddenPackages.description: Package names or scoped package globs that must not survive tree shaking.

allowedViolations.description: Bundle-size fixture paths mapped to forbidden packages tolerated as tracked debt. Fixture paths use forward slashes and are relative to fixturesRoot.

items.description: Exact resolved package name. Globs are rejected so a tolerated leak cannot silently cover a new one.
